title: Structural interpretability in SVMs with truncated orthogonal polynomial kernels
abstract: arXiv:2604.15285v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Support vector machines (SVMs) can yield classifiers with similar predictive performance but different internal structures, particularly in the contributions of individual explanatory variables and their interactions. We introduce Orthogonal Representation Contribution Analysis (ORCA), a post-training methodology for SVMs constructed from tensor products of truncated Christoffel--Darboux kernels. The associated reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) admits a finite orthonormal polynomial basis in which the regularized component of the fitted decision function has an exact expansion. Squared expansion coefficients induce an additive decomposition of its squared RKHS norm. Based on this representation, normalized Orthogonal Kernel Contribution (OKC) indices quantify the fractions of the squared RKHS norm associated with total polynomial degrees, interaction orders, and input-variable contributions, both individually and through

translated_title: 基于截断正交多项式核的支持向量机的结构可解释性
translated_abstract: 支持向量机（SVM）可以产生预测性能相似但内部结构不同的分类器，尤其是在各个解释变量的贡献及其交互作用方面存在差异。我们提出了正交表示贡献分析，这是一种针对由截断Christoffel–Darboux核的张量积构建的支持向量机的训练后分析方法。相应的再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）具有有限的标准正交多项式基，拟合决策函数的正则化部分在该基下具有精确的展开形式。展开系数的平方诱导出其RKHS范数平方的加性分解。基于这一表示，归一化的正交核贡献（OKC）指数量化了与总多项式次数、交互阶数以及输入变量贡献（包括单独贡献和通过交互作用产生的贡献）相关的RKHS范数平方的比例。
tldr: 该论文提出了正交表示贡献分析（ORCA）方法，利用截断正交多项式核SVM的有限标准正交多项式基展开，通过正交核贡献（OKC）指数精确量化各输入变量、交互阶数及多项式次数对决策函数的贡献，从而实现对支持向量机的结构可解释性分析。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ORCA, a post-training methodology that exploits the exact polynomial basis expansion of truncated orthogonal polynomial kernel SVMs to quantify structural contributions of input variables, interaction orders, and polynomial degrees via normalized Orthogonal Kernel Contribution (OKC) indices.
